描述_EN: camels and horses were used as pack animals and merchants passed their goods from oasis to oasis. their original purpose is unclear although they are likely to have had a utilitarian function. the victoria and albert museum has around 700 ancient and medieval textiles recovered by stein at the beginning of the twentieth century. these fragments were brought back from central asia by the explorer and archaeologist sir marc aurel stein (1862–1943). these miscellaneous fragments include a bundle of string made of twisted grass, a piece of plain woven buff plant fibre and fragments of plain weave brown silk. the most notable item traded was silk. the site is part of an area now referred to as the silk road, a series of overland trade routes that crossed asia, from china to europe. the silk road was also important for the exchange of ideas – while silk textiles travelled west from china, buddhism entered china from india in this way. they were recovered from the site known as the limes watchtowers, a line of fortified encampments designed to ensure the safe transit of goods across the area and dating from 200bc to ad400. some are silk while others are made from the wool of a variety of different animals. the textiles range in date from the second century bc to the twelfth century ad.
描述_ZN: 年，骆驼和马被用作驮运动物，商人们在绿洲之间传递他们的货物。 年，它们的原始用途不清楚，尽管它们可能具有功利性的功能。 年，维多利亚和阿尔伯特博物馆有大约700件古代和中世纪的纺织品，是斯坦在20世纪初找到的。 年，这些碎片被探险家和考古学家Marc Aurel Stein先生（1862-1943）从中亚带回来。 年，这些杂项碎片包括一捆由扭曲的草制成的绳子、一块平纹水草纤维和平纹棕色丝绸的碎片。 年，最引人注目的贸易项目是丝绸。 年：该遗址是现在被称为 "丝绸之路 "的地区的一部分，这是一系列横跨亚洲、从中国到欧洲的陆上贸易路线。 年：丝绸之路对思想交流也很重要--当丝绸纺织品从中国向西运输时，佛教也通过这种方式从印度进入中国。 它们是从被称为莱姆斯瞭望塔的遗址中发现的，这是一排坚固的营地，旨在确保货物在该地区的安全运输，可以追溯到公元前200年到公元400年。 有些是丝绸，有些则是由各种不同动物的羊毛制成。 这些纺织品的年代从公元前二世纪到公元十二世纪不等。
